acceptance_2_issued_least_role_credentia.principal: CONSULTATION_CASE_FILE_RESEARCH_READ_TOKEN: subject pantheon-dev-consultation-case-file-research-reader, roles ['service'], scope pantheon:dev-owner-read, tenant-dev only, file-delivered to consultation-svc only (/run/pantheon-principals/CONSULTATION_CASE_FILE_RESEARCH_READ_TOKEN); revoked with the other principals.
acceptance_2_issued_least_role_credentia.why_service_is_the_narrowest_admitted_ro: Of the roles the owner-binding route admits, registry-writer would mutate the Registry; operator/admin/approver/governance_reviewer/risk_owner/governance_committee/automated_gate are decision roles. The research write owner honours 'service' only for named subjects (_ACTION_CONTROLLERS consultation-svc, persona-pool-cycle; ticket reviewer_id), which this distinct read subject is not. Scope is not enforced by any owner today, so the distinct subject is the effective boundary.
acceptance_2_issued_least_role_credentia.selection: Owners.from_env(token_keys=...) lets a caller name its own credential per owner; the consultation executor passes CASE_FILE_TOKEN_KEYS = {'research': 'CONSULTATION_CASE_FILE_RESEARCH_READ_TOKEN'} at both call sites (_compose_panel_case_file, _probe_case_file_credentials). Configured-but-unreadable file => empty credential (fail closed), never the shared viewer. Persona cycle / research demand / evolution executor callers are unchanged.

acceptance_4_claim_subject_mismatch_attr.why_not_read: This worker has no hosted read path: gcloud reauthentication is required (non-interactive refresh fails) and no DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_* transport credentials are present. The raw 2026-11-24 contribution bodies for consult-envelope-publication-68ffaa6c8e39... were therefore not inspected; the memo only carried the bare code 'claim_subject_mismatch' with no field, which is itself part of the defect fixed under acceptance 5.
comparison_defects_found_in_code: Multi-family merge in _compose_panel_case_file overwrote case.subject.strategy_family with a space-joined label ('fam_a fam_b'); a claim asserting one real family of the pool while citing the pool item, a backtest verdict or memory (none carry strategy_family) could never match.

Collections on the owner side were compared by whole-value equality only: one underlying of subject.underlyings, one ref of member_artifact_refs, a subset of registry parameters, or one member object of the pool's members list were all rejected although the cited owner states them.
acceptance_4_claim_subject_mismatch_attr.fix: case.subject.strategy_families (list) is kept beside the display label for multi-family cases; _subject_value_attributed accepts a scalar member of a list or a sub-object of an object, with JSON-type-strict scalar equality ("20" != 20, 0 != false); nothing absent from the cited item or case subject is ever attributed; None/empty values stay rejected.
